summary.zh-CN: Chromium 浏览器与 EchoAgent 页面助手
summary.en: Chromium browser with an EchoAgent page assistant

description.zh-CN: 浏览器用于打开网页、管理标签页和地址栏、保留登录态，并提供 EchoAgent 侧栏，支持围绕当前页面进行查询、整理和辅助操作。
description.en: Browser opens web pages, manages tabs and the address bar, preserves login state, and provides an EchoAgent sidebar for page-aware Q&A, organization, and assistance.
